snippet.title: Neon Hearts City - A retro point-and-click adventure set in a grungy cyberpunk city of the future!
snippet.description:
Purchase on itch.io https://cosmicvoid.itch.io/neon-hearts-city?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A private investigator, hot on the trail of a missing person, stumbles upon a conspiracy of zealots lurking in the city's hidden underworld. Neon Hearts City is a retro point-and-click adventure that thrusts you into a grungy cyberpunk city of the future.

While searching for Audrey, a missing young girl, Elijah Crow uncovers a sinister plot targeting society’s outcasts.Somewhere along the shore, androids longing to become human are offered as sacrifices.
Far out at sea, a mysterious tower harbors secrets that could unravel the fabric of civilization.

Suspended in the sky, Roark Prison looms—a colossal airship where thought criminals face imprisonment.Somehow, these threads are inextricably intertwined.
